utterances.text: I built the inventory update endpoint. I used a client supplied idempotency key and a unique database constraint. I stored the result in the same transaction as the update, so a retry returned the saved result. In a sample test with one hundred requests, including twenty duplicates, each unique update applied once. The tradeoff was storing request results and deciding when to expire them.
